summary: Moses says all commandment you shall observe to do that you may live multiply go in possess land swore to fathers, you shall remember all the way which Yahweh led you these 40 years in wilderness to humble prove know what was in heart whether you would keep commandments. He humbled, suffered to hunger, fed with manna which you and fathers didn't know that he might make you know man does not live by bread only but by everything proceeding out of mouth of Yahweh. Raiment didn't wax old foot not swollen 40 years. Know as man chastens son so Yahweh chastens you. For Yahweh brings into good land of brooks water fountains depths hills valleys wheat barley vines figs pomegranates olives honey land where eat bread without scarceness, shall eat be full bless Yahweh for good land. Beware lest forget Yahweh when you have eaten full built goodly houses herds flocks multiply silver gold multiplied all you have multiplied then heart be lifted say my power and might of my hand gotten me this wealth but remember Yahweh gave power to get wealth to establish covenant swore to fathers. If you forget go after other gods serve worship I testify against you you shall surely perish as nations Yahweh destroys.
whyItMatters: Man does not live by bread alone, humility via hunger and manna, remember all the way 40 years, beware when full lest forget and say my power got this wealth.

keyVerses.text: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of Yahweh’s mouth.
and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”
keyVerses.why: Warning against my power got wealth — remember Yahweh gives power.

questions.question: What does 'man does not live by bread only but by everything proceeding out of mouth of Yahweh' mean?
questions.answer: In wilderness Israel hungered then fed manna unknown to them and fathers — new food to teach dependence: physical bread sustains but not only, need every word/promise proceeding from Yahweh's mouth. Jesus quotes to Satan in temptation when told turn stones to bread — refuses to use power to meet legitimate need apart from Father's word, trusting every word. For first-time reader, means life is more than material fullness, needs divine word for life.

questions.question: Why remember all the way 40 years to humble and prove what was in heart?
questions.answer: All the way which Yahweh led these 40 years in wilderness to humble you, prove you, know what was in heart whether you would keep commandments. Humble = anah afflict, make dependent. Prove = test. Wilderness Reveals heart — grumbling, manna hoarding, etc. Raiment didn't wax old foot not swollen — miraculous preservation, yet God as man chastens son so Yahweh chastens you. Discipline as love, not rejection. Remembering prevents amnesia when in good land.

questions.question: Why beware when you have eaten full built goodly houses herds multiply silver gold then say my power got wealth?
questions.answer: Moses anticipates prosperity danger: when eat full, houses goodly, herds flocks multiply, silver gold multiplied, all you have multiplied, then heart lifted and forget Yahweh who brought from Egyptian bondage, led through great terrible wilderness fiery serpents scorpions thirsty, brought water from rock, fed manna. Alternative narrative emerges: my power and might of my hand has gotten me this wealth — self-made myth. But remember Yahweh gave power to get wealth to establish covenant swore to fathers. Wealth as ability, not just possession, given to fulfill promise. If forget go after other gods serve worship I testify you shall surely perish as nations Yahweh destroys. For modern affluence, warning pertinent.
